name: Winterworks
description: A winter mod: the Snowball Launcher, the Icebreaker, the Winter Express trains and the Snow Globe. The Cold Zone: Ice Caves, the cold, remade polar bears, fur armour, the Frost Mauler boss and Fang Daggers. The Amber Age: archaeology everywhere, the Dead Caves, Dig Sites, amber, mosquitoes, sniffers and the Pot Golem. Hexes & Havoc: the Hex Fortress, the Piglin Witch, the Golden Piglin, elixirs, the Soul Tank, the Hexing Table, Hexed Books, poetic curses and the Seven Deadly Sins. The Living End: Chorus Meadows and the Dead End, floating islands, eclipses, Enderflies, Endlings, Guckers, Obolisks, Dragonlings, the End Glider, a harder Ender Dragon and the Monolith. Models, textures and animations are made with lowpix.
